description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the GeoZone model in the OpenCart system, specifically within the Catalog's Localisation namespace. The class provides methods to retrieve geo zone information from the database, such as getting a specific geo zone by ID, as well as retrieving all geo zones.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Represents the GeoZone model in the Localisation namespace, providing methods to access geo zone data from the database.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific geo zone based on geo zone ID, country ID, and zone ID.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all geo zones ordered by name.
